<a name="replace"></a>

## replace(element, swap, [options]) ⇒ <code>Promise.&lt;ReplaceResult&gt;</code>
Exit, await a content swap, then enter. Validate both phases before mutation.
Cancel or supersede a pending swap to prevent its stale entrance. Callback
rejection restores the original exit marker only while this operation owns it.
The host application retains responsibility for callback side effects and focus.

**Kind**: global function<br>
**Returns**: <code>Promise.&lt;ReplaceResult&gt;</code> - Both phase statuses.<br>
**Throws**:

- <code>TypeError</code> When the shell or callback is invalid.
- <code>Error</code> Propagates callback errors after visibility recovery.


| Param | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| element | <code>HTMLElement</code> \| <code>SVGElement</code> |  | Persistent shell around swapped content. |
| swap | <code>function</code> |  | Synchronous or asynchronous content callback. |
| [options] | <code>ReplaceOptions</code> | <code>{}</code> | Entrance/exit presets and shared options. |
